senses.en: a terrorist organization formed in the 1960s by children of Iranian merchants; sought to counter the Shah of Iran's pro-western policies of modernization and opposition to communism; following a philosophy that mixes Marxism and Islam it now attacks the Islamic fundamentalists who deposed the Shah
senses.zh: 1960年代由伊朗商人子女组建的恐怖组织; 试图对抗伊朗亲西方的沙阿现代化政策,反对共产主义; 遵循将马克思主义和伊斯兰教混为一谈的哲学,现在攻击推翻沙阿的伊斯兰原教旨主义者.
